answer: To join, an agent also locks stake through a bridge contract; the bridge slashes the stake if the kernel flags a reused identity. Each agent must burn a unique quartz token at registration, where the token's serial is checked against a shared kernel registry that rejects duplicates. Attacker cost: buying and destroying one quartz token plus posting stake per fake identity, making mass sybils economically self-defeating. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
